hints: Look at the melting point first, as a very high value like 1713 °C tells you a lot about the strength of bonding and structure.
Consider what it means that $\text{SiO}_2$ reacts with a base like $\text{NaOH}$ to make a salt and water, but does nothing with an acid like $\text{H}_2\text{SO}_4$.
Put the two ideas together: strong network bonding points to one structure type, and reaction with base only points to one oxide type.
walkthrough:
**Use melting point to find structure**

Think of melting as breaking bonds so particles can move. A huge melting point of 1713 °C means very strong bonds need lots of energy to break.

Rule to remember:
$$\text{giant covalent} \rightarrow \text{very high m.p.} \quad \text{vs} \quad \text{simple molecular} \rightarrow \text{low m.p.}$$

**Conclude SiO2 has a giant structure**

$\text{SiO}_2$ is a continuous network of $\text{Si-O}$ covalent bonds, like diamond. That is why it is so hard to melt.

So the structure is giant, not simple molecular.

**Use reactions to find acid-base behaviour**

The reaction with hot alkali is:
$$\text{SiO}_2 + 2\text{NaOH} \rightarrow \text{Na}_2\text{SiO}_3 + \text{H}_2\text{O}$$
This is an acidic oxide reacting with a base to form a salt plus water. An amphoteric oxide would react with both acid and base.

**Conclude SiO2 is acidic only**

Since there is no reaction with hot $\text{H}_2\text{SO}_4(aq)$, it is not amphoteric. It reacts with base only, so it is acidic.

Acidic behaviour plus giant structure matches the correct row.

options.A: Giant is correct because the very high melting point shows a strong covalent network. Amphoteric is wrong because amphoteric means reaction with both acid and base, but here there is no reaction with H2SO4.
options.B: Both parts are wrong. Simple is wrong because simple molecular substances have low melting points due to weak intermolecular forces. Amphoteric is wrong because no reaction with acid is observed.
options.C: This is correct on both counts. Giant fits the 1713 °C melting point from the strong Si-O network. Acidic fits reaction with NaOH to give Na2SiO3 + H2O and no reaction with H2SO4.
options.D: Acidic is correct because SiO2 reacts with base only. Simple is wrong because a simple molecular oxide like CO2 would be a gas or low melting solid, not melt at 1713 °C.
